scene: The barista pours tea while recommending three bustling city transit gates outside.
picture: Side-scrolling view of the tea room rear terrace along red brick paving. On the far left stands a chrome hover metro gate. Left of centre, Granny and her dog listen to the four-armed brass barista holding a kettle. Through an archway at centre sits a yellow flying scooter. On the right, a gondola drone hovers.
shown: a sleek hover metro turnstile gleaming on the far left
a glowing yellow flying scooter parked outside the open doorway at centre
a wicker-basket gondola drone hovering moored by the window on the right
